title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on the Division of Work in Handling Cases Where Administrative Organs Apply to the People's Court for Compulsory Enforcement
keywords_en: administrative litigation; case of applying to the people's court for compulsory enforcement
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on the Division of Work in Cases Where Administrative Organs Apply to the People's Court for Compulsory Enforcement

Fa Fa [1996] No. 12

All local people's courts at various levels, all military courts, all railway transport intermediate and basic courts, and all maritime courts:

With respect to the division of work between the administrative adjudication tribunals and enforcement divisions of the people's courts in cases where administrative organs apply for compulsory enforcement pursuant to Article 66 of the Administrative Procedure Law, upon study, the following notice is hereby issued:

Cases where administrative organs apply to the people's court for compulsory enforcement shall be reviewed by the administrative adjudication tribunal. If, through education, the counterparty to the administrative act voluntarily complies, the case may be closed. Where compulsory enforcement is necessary, the administrative adjudication tribunal shall transfer the case to the enforcement division.

April 29, 1996
